location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, study room

goal.en: Plan a group presentation with Leo and Yuki.
goal.zh: 和里歐、由紀一起規劃小組報告。

background: small study room with a round table, three chairs, a laptop, colorful blank sticky notes scattered on the table, a whiteboard wiped clean, warm afternoon light

intro.en: Ms. Reed gave a group project: a five-minute presentation about Maple Bay.
intro.zh: 瑞德老師出了小組作業：做一份五分鐘的楓灣介紹報告。

intro.en: OK, team. What should our topic be?
intro.zh: 好，各位。我們的主題要做什麼？

lines.en: Hmm. History? Nature? I have no idea.
lines.zh: 嗯……歷史？大自然？我完全沒頭緒。

choices.en: How about the food in Maple Bay?
choices.tip: How about + 名詞／V-ing? 是提出建議的好用句型，語氣輕鬆，不會強迫別人。

choices.en: How about do the food of Maple Bay?

lines.en: "Do the food"? You mean... cook it? In class?
lines.zh: 「做食物」？你是說……在課堂上煮菜嗎？

story.en: Yuki starts planning a cooking demo with a rice cooker. Ms. Reed is not sure the classroom allows open fire.
story.zh: 由紀開始規劃用電鍋做料理示範。瑞德老師不確定教室能不能開火。

fail.why: How about 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞。中文「做美食主題」的「做」不用翻。直接說 How about the food in Maple Bay?。

choices.en: Food. That's the best. No discussion.
choices.zh: 美食。那個最好，不用討論了。

lines.en: No discussion? Isn't this a group project?
lines.zh: 不用討論？這不是小組作業嗎？

story.en: Leo and Yuki quietly start their own plan. You find out at the presentation that you are in a group of one.
story.zh: 里歐和由紀默默開始自己的計畫。直到報告當天，你才發現自己變成一人小組。

fail.why: No discussion. 聽起來很霸道，像在下命令。小組討論時用建議的語氣：How about the food in Maple Bay?。

lines.en: Food! I love it. But how do we show it?
lines.zh: 美食！我喜歡。但我們要怎麼呈現？

choices.en: Why don't we film a short video about it?
choices.zh: 我們何不拍一段相關的短片？
choices.tip: Why don't we...? 不是在問原因，而是「我們何不……」的建議句。

choices.en: Show? Yes, I like cooking shows.
choices.zh: 節目？對啊，我喜歡料理節目。

lines.en: Um, I said "show it," not "a show."
lines.zh: 呃，我是說「呈現」，不是「節目」。

story.en: You spend twenty minutes sharing your favorite cooking shows. The sticky notes are still blank.
story.zh: 你花了二十分鐘分享最愛的料理節目。桌上的便利貼還是一片空白。

fail.why: show it 是動詞「呈現」，a show 才是「節目」。沒聽清楚就問 Sorry, show it how?，再提出建議：Why don't we film a short video?。

choices.en: Why we don't make a short video?
choices.zh: 我們為什麼不做一段短片？

lines.en: Why we don't? Uh... because nobody said it yet?
lines.zh: 我們為什麼不做？呃……因為還沒人提吧？

story.en: Leo thinks you are asking for a reason. The team spends ten minutes explaining why nobody made a video yet.
story.zh: 里歐以為你在問原因。整組花了十分鐘解釋為什麼還沒人做影片。

fail.why: 疑問句要倒裝：Why don't we...?，不是 Why we don't...?。語序錯了，聽起來就像真的在問原因。

lines.en: Great idea! I can write the script. What about you, Kai?
lines.zh: 好主意！我可以寫腳本。凱，你呢？

choices.en: I can take care of the filming.
choices.tip: take care of 除了「照顧」，也表示「負責處理」。主動認領工作，在小組裡很加分。

choices.en: Me? I'm not good at anything. Sorry.

lines.en: Nothing at all? But you take great photos!
lines.zh: 完全不會？可是你照片拍得很好啊！

story.en: Leo and Yuki spend ten minutes cheering you up. In the end, Yuki gives you the job of bringing snacks.
story.zh: 里歐和由紀花了十分鐘幫你打氣。最後，由紀派給你的工作是帶零食。

fail.why: 台灣人習慣謙虛說「我不太會」，但在國外的小組裡，這會讓人以為你不想幫忙。說出自己能做的事：I can take care of the filming.。

choices.en: I can taking care of filming.

lines.en: Taking care... of a film? Like a pet?
lines.zh: 照顧……一部電影？像養寵物那樣？

story.en: Yuki draws a cute camera with a baby bottle on a sticky note. It's very funny, but it's not a plan.
story.zh: 由紀在便利貼上畫了一台拿著奶瓶的可愛相機。很好笑，但不是計畫。

fail.why: can 後面要接原形動詞：I can take care of...，不是 can taking。the filming 前面的 the 也不能少。

lines.en: Perfect! So when should we meet again?
lines.zh: 太好了！那我們什麼時候再碰面？

choices.en: How about this Thursday after class?
choices.zh: 這個星期四下課後怎麼樣？
choices.tip: 回答「什麼時候」要給具體時間。How about + 時間? 是提議時間的簡單說法。

lines.en: Meat on Thursday? Is that a barbecue party?
lines.zh: 星期四吃肉？是要辦烤肉派對嗎？

story.en: Leo gets very excited about a barbecue. You spend the next meeting grilling sausages, not editing videos.
story.zh: 里歐對烤肉超興奮。下次聚會，你們都在烤香腸，沒在剪影片。

fail.why: How about 後面接 V-ing：How about meeting on Thursday?。meet 單獨出現又很像 meat（肉）。更簡單的說法是 How about Thursday after class?。

choices.en: Yes, we should meet again soon.
choices.zh: 對，我們應該快點再碰面。

lines.en: Yes... but when? That was my question.
lines.zh: 對……但是什麼時候？我就是在問這個。

story.en: Everyone agrees to meet "soon," and nobody picks a day. The presentation is next Monday.
story.zh: 大家都同意「快點」碰面，卻沒人訂日子。而報告就在下週一。

fail.why: 對方問 when，就要回答具體時間，不能只說 soon。直接提出時間：How about Thursday after class?。

lines.en: Me too. Team Food is ready!

story.en: In thirty minutes, your team has a topic, a plan and a meeting day. The sticky notes are finally full.
story.zh: 三十分鐘內，你們就訂好主題、分工和聚會時間。便利貼終於寫滿了。

notes.explain: 提出建議的句型，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞。例如 How about pizza? / How about going hiking?。

example.en: How about meeting at the library?
example.zh: 約在圖書館碰面怎麼樣？

notes.explain: 看起來像問原因，其實是建議。語序是 Why don't we + 原形動詞，不要寫成 Why we don't...。

example.en: Why don't we take a break?

notes.explain: take care of 也有「負責處理」的意思。在小組裡主動認領工作，比說「我都可以」更受歡迎。

example.en: Don't worry. I can take care of the slides.

notes.explain: meet（見面）和 meat（肉）發音完全一樣。句子講完整一點，例如 meet up、meeting，就比較不會被聽錯。
在國外的小組作業中，安靜和過度謙虛常被當成不參與。主動提出想法、認領工作，才會被當成好隊友。

example.en: I have an idea. Why don't we add some interviews?
example.zh: 我有個想法。我們何不加一些訪談？
